summary: Harden descriptor-relative file reads, discovery gating, and schema parity in conformance

delivery.outcome: Anchor root-bounded file reads via descriptor-relative O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW traversal, eliminate digest-to-parse double-open TOCTOU, gate CLI discovery on interface-profile validation, and enforce full schema parity in usage conformance.
nonGoals: No breaking changes to published v1/v2 JSON schemas or profile SHA-256 digests

architecture.decision: Extract descriptor-anchored file I/O and Git repository identity inspection into docs/standard/repository_identity.py (<250L), use openat-style dir_fd O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW traversal in runtime_conformance.py and standard/repository_identity.py, parse artifact JSON from the exact bytes hashed by check(), skip discover() on invalid interface profiles, and enforce full schema parity.
architecture.rollback: Revert descriptor-relative read and schema-parity hardening commit on docs/communication and docs/standard.

validation.evidence: All conformance checks, adversarial unit tests, ruff checks, governance-check.sh, and wellman check pass with 0 errors.
